spec.jackknife: closed-form SE of a mean, sqrt(sum (x_i-mean)^2 / (n*(n-1))); 90% band = mean +/- 1.6449*SE
spec.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap of the mean, 2000 draws, fixed seed 20261022 (reproducible by seed, no panel read)
spec.gap_interval: mid-minus-me, books resampled independently, SEs added in quadrature; the two books decide on different calendar dates (30 me vs 29 mid15 in 2021_2023) so nothing pairs date-to-date, but they hold the same names over the same era, which makes the true difference error SMALLER than this quadrature band -- the gap band is conservative
spec.interval_meaning: sampling noise of the transition sample only: cells are monthly decisions on overlapping holdings, not iid prints, so no significance claim is made and no cell is called positive or negative on the strength of its band
spec.descriptive_only: no prereg, no judgement, zero ledger booking
